about_the_game:
Thank you for your interest in TEST RE!

This DLC is a way for players to support the game's developers.
By purchasing it, you help future development of TEST RE and the QuietMansion series.

As a token of our appreciation, buyers of this DLC will unlock the following weapons in TEST RE, with unlimited ammunition.

・Shotgun
・Sniper rifle
・Magnum
・Rocket launcher

※When TEST RE is launched with the downloadable content purchased, it will be automatically reflected.
